errors.network: Network problem. Check your connection and try again.

errors.notFound: Not found, or you do not have access to it.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.

login.heroTitle: Every institution, one safe path for the child.
login.heroBody: Tuliwamu helps police, health workers, prosecutors, courts and social welfare officers coordinate referrals — and lets children and authorised caregivers follow approved progress in plain language.
login.q2: Where is my case in the process?
login.q4: Is there anything I need to attend or do?
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the account given to you by your institution or support officer.
login.demoBody: Pick an account to fill the form. All demo accounts use the password

notice.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
notice.idleLogout: You were signed out after a period of inactivity to protect your information.

recovery.title: Account recovery
recovery.beneficiaryNote: Children and caregivers: please ask your support officer to help you get back into your account. This keeps your account safe on shared phones.
recovery.resetDone: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in.

about.title: Safeguarding & privacy
about.p1: Tuliwamu coordinates referrals between authorised institutions. Each institution sees only what it needs for its role, and everything sensitive is logged.
about.p2: Families only see messages that an officer has reviewed and approved. Investigation notes, medical details, evidence and witness information are never shown in the family portal or sent by SMS.
about.emergencyTitle: If a child is in danger now
about.emergency: Call the Child Helpline 116 (toll-free) or the police on 999 / 112. Verify numbers locally before go-live.
about.p3: On a shared phone, use the Quick exit button and sign out when you finish. You will be signed out automatically after a few minutes without activity.

overview.incomingSubtitle: Acknowledge promptly so the sender knows the child is being seen.
overview.adminSubtitle: Manage accounts, institutions and services, and monitor security.
overview.adminNoCaseAccess: Administrators do not have access to case content.

cases.title: Cases
cases.subtitle: Cases on which your institution is part of the case team.
cases.searchPlaceholder: Search by reference, pseudonym or district
cases.emptyHint: Cases appear here when your institution registers one or acknowledges a referral.

caseNew.title: Register a case
caseNew.subtitle: Record only what is needed to coordinate support. The system generates a unique case reference.
caseNew.minimisation: Use a pseudonym, never the child's real name, in this prototype. Collect only information needed for referrals.
caseNew.externalRefHint: Optional. Fictional values only in demonstrations.
caseNew.assignedOfficerHint: Officer in your institution responsible for this case.
caseNew.restrictedHint: Visible only to your institution. Shared with others only if you explicitly include it in a referral.
caseNew.immediateRisk: The child may need immediate protection
caseNew.immediateRiskHint: Flags the case and suggests urgent referrals.
caseNew.needsHint: Tick the services the child is likely to need. You will make each referral from the case page.
caseNew.confirmNotDuplicate: It is not a duplicate — register

caseDetail.createdBody: Case {ref} has been created and the first status was recorded. Next, make the referrals the child needs.
caseDetail.restrictedHidden: Restricted details (protection concerns, exact location) are visible only to the lead institution.
caseDetail.stageHint: Stages describe the official process. Your role can only set the stages listed. Families are not told automatically.
caseDetail.proposeFamily: Also propose a message for the family
caseDetail.proposeFamilyHint: A different authorised officer must approve it before the family sees it.
caseDetail.familyMessageHint: Plain language. No investigation, medical, evidence or witness details.

timeline.needsOtherReviewer: Another officer must review this message.
timeline.reviewRule: Institutional updates never reach the family automatically. Messages marked “awaiting review” need approval by a different authorised officer.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.subtitle: Purpose-specific referrals between institutions, with a full audit trail.
referrals.emptyCaseHint: You see referrals your institution sent or received.

referralNew.title: Make a referral
referralNew.purpose: Purpose and what you are asking for
referralNew.purposeHint: Be specific. Do not include details that are not needed for this service.
referralNew.shareHint: Only ticked items are shared (minimum necessary). The receiver sees nothing else until it acknowledges, and even then not your restricted details.
referralNew.visibleToFamily: Tell the family that this service has been arranged
referralNew.visibleToFamilyHint: Shows only the type of service, after an officer approves the message.

referralDetail.ackBody: Acknowledging tells the sender you have received it and adds your institution to the case team with limited access.
referralDetail.sharedHint: Snapshot of the fields the sender chose to share.
referralDetail.outcomeSummaryHint: Short and non-clinical, e.g. “Examination completed; official form issued.”
referralDetail.restrictedNotesHint: Never shared with the sender, the case team or the family.
referralDetail.snapshotOnly: You can see only the referral snapshot until you acknowledge it.
referralDetail.completeFamilyNote: A plain-language family message will be proposed automatically and must be approved by an authorised officer.

appointments.title: Appointments & hearings
appointments.subtitle: Appointments and court hearings for cases on your team.
appointments.locationHint: Shown to the family. Use a public place name only.
appointments.familyNoteHint: e.g. who will meet them and when.
appointments.visibleToFamilyHint: Discreet reminders are sent to authorised family members.
appointments.attendees: Who from the family needs to come
appointments.attendeesHint: Shown to the complainant / caregiver with the date and place.

followUps.title: Follow-ups
followUps.subtitle: Tasks that keep a case moving — including responses to family requests.
followUps.emptyCase: No follow-ups for this case yet.

grants.title: Who can follow this case
grants.subtitle: Portal access for the child and caregivers — explicit, per case, approved by two officers.
grants.empty: No one has portal access to this case.
grants.notPermitted: Only the lead institution and probation officers manage family access.
grants.safeguardBody: Never grant access to anyone implicated in the allegation or whose access may not be in the child's best interests. A second officer must approve this request.
grants.usernameHint: The caregiver or child account created by your administrator.
grants.basis: Why this is in the child's best interests
grants.conflictCheck: I confirm this person is not implicated in the allegation and that access is in the child's best interests.

reviews.title: Family update reviews
reviews.subtitle: Messages proposed for children and caregivers that need your approval.
reviews.rule: You cannot approve a message you wrote. Check that it is plain, kind and contains no investigation, medical, evidence or witness details.
reviews.editHint: You may adjust the wording before approving.

assistance.title: Family requests
assistance.subtitle: Requests for help sent from the child / caregiver portal.
assistance.responseHint: They will see this in the portal. Keep it simple and safe.

assistanceType.QUESTION: I have a question about my case

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Notifications never contain case details. Open the item to see more.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Changes the whole interface without losing your work.
settings.discreetNote: SMS and email messages are always discreet: they never mention the child, the allegation or case details.
settings.smsConsent: I agree to receive discreet SMS messages
settings.smsConsentHint: Your consent is recorded. You can withdraw it at any time.
settings.safePhoneHint: A number only you (or a trusted person) can see.
settings.safePhoneSet: A safe number is saved. Enter a new one to replace it.
settings.passwordHint: At least 10 characters; not a common password.

anon.title: Anonymous reports
anon.subtitle: Concerns received anonymously through USSD. Only police officers can see them; they stay separate from official cases until assessed.
anon.unverifiedBody: An anonymous report is not a proven allegation. Assess it, record the outcome and only open an official case where justified.
anon.dangerNow: Reporter says a child is in danger now
anon.reportHint: Reporter's words. Phone numbers are not stored unless the reporter chose to give one.
anon.convertHint: Only after assessment shows action is needed. The report stays linked for traceability.
anon.pseudonymHint: Leave blank to use a neutral placeholder.

ussd.title: USSD simulator
ussd.subtitle: Try the feature-phone reporting journey without a mobile network.
ussd.sameEngineTitle: Same engine as the real gateway
ussd.sameEngine: This simulator calls the exact USSD logic that answers Africa's Talking callbacks. Reports created here are labelled “Simulator”.
ussd.privacy: No name, ID or phone number is required. The mobile network can still see that a session took place — the menu explains this before submission.
ussd.try2: Choose 1 to report a concern and answer the short questions.
ussd.try3: Note the reference and PIN shown at the end.
ussd.try4: Dial again, choose 2 and enter the reference and PIN to check status.
ussd.try5: Police officers then review it under Anonymous reports.
ussd.anonymousNote: Reports made by USSD are anonymous: they are not linked to your account and you will not see them on your home page. Keep the reference and PIN to check the status by USSD.

sms.title: SMS delivery
sms.subtitle: Discreet notifications sent by SMS, with honest delivery tracking.
sms.mockTitle: Mock provider — nothing is sent to real phones
sms.mockBody: Africa's Talking credentials are not configured, so messages are recorded as “Simulated”. They are never shown as delivered.
sms.liveBody: “Accepted by provider” means the API accepted the request. Only a delivery report marks a message as delivered.
sms.recentHint: Phone numbers are masked. Message text is a fixed discreet template.

analytics.title: Anonymised analytics
analytics.subtitle: Aggregate indicators only. Groups smaller than {k} are suppressed.
analytics.privacy: No case records, references or names are shown. Locations are grouped by region, time by month, and any count below {k} is hidden. Age, location and category are never combined.
analytics.byRegionHint: Region level only to protect children in small communities.
analytics.byStageHint: Not every case passes through every stage.
analytics.monthlyHint: Hover a column for the value.
analytics.gapsHint: Automatically flagged patterns to investigate — not judgements about institutions.
analytics.stale: Referrals unacknowledged for more than 7 days

admin.usersSubtitle: Create accounts and assign roles and institutions.
admin.name: Name
admin.supervisorHint: Supervisors can view anonymised analytics and receive anonymous-report alerts.
admin.noCaseAccess: Creating or editing accounts does not give the administrator access to any case content.
admin.institutionsSubtitle: Participating institutions. All demo institutions are fictional.
admin.publicContactHint: An institutional line — never a personal number.
admin.servicesSubtitle: Directory shown to children and caregivers.
admin.auditSubtitle: Who did what, when. Values of sensitive fields are never stored here.
admin.auditSearch: Search action, object ID or username

ben.intro: Here you can follow the progress of your case in simple words. Only information checked by your support officer is shown.

q.attend: Is there anything I need to attend?

ben.noCasesHint: Your support officer will tell you when you can follow a case here.
ben.timelineHint: These messages were checked by your support officer.
ben.emergencyTitle: If you are in danger now
ben.emergency: Call the Child Helpline 116 (free) or the police on 999 / 112.
ben.tip1: Use “Quick exit” to leave the page immediately.
ben.tip2: Always sign out when you finish, especially on a shared phone.
ben.tip3: You will be signed out automatically after 10 minutes without activity.
ben.tip4: Messages from Tuliwamu never say what your case is about.
ben.messagesBody: Any SMS from us only says you have an update or an appointment. Your support officer can change how you are contacted.

help.title: Message your support officer
help.intro: Your message goes to the officer handling your case. They will reply here or contact you safely.
help.safetyNow: If you are in danger right now, call 116 or the police on 999 / 112. Your request is also sent to your officer as a priority.
help.messageHint: You don't need to write details about what happened.
help.sent: Your support officer has been told. You will see their reply below.

support.title: Support services
support.intro: Free and confidential services that can help you and your family.

attendees.CHILD_AND_CAREGIVER: You and the child need to come
attendees.CHILD: The child needs to come (with a trusted adult)
attendees.NOT_REQUIRED: You do not need to come

welcome.title: Welcome, {name}
welcome.body: This is a safe place to tell the police what happened to a child. You can speak in your own language or write it down. A police officer will listen and get back to you.
welcome.ctaHint: It takes about 5 minutes. You can record a voice note in Luganda, Acholi or English.
welcome.step1Body: Record a voice note or write what happened. You do not have to give names.
welcome.step2Body: A police officer reviews your report and answers you within 24 hours, in your language.
welcome.step3Body: Once the case is registered you can see every step, upcoming dates and the support arranged for you.
welcome.privacy1: Only the police officers handling your report can read or listen to it.
welcome.privacy2: Your voice note is stored encrypted and is never shown to anyone else.
welcome.privacy3: Text messages from us never say what your report is about.

dashboard.intro: Here you can follow your reports and cases. This page updates by itself.
dashboard.reportsInReview: Reports being checked by the police

report.title: Tell us what happened
report.intro: Take your time. You can stop at any point. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
report.otherChildHint: You will be told when the police have handled it, but not the details of that child's case.
report.districtHint: For example Kampala, Gulu or Wakiso. No house details needed.
report.dangerNow: Is a child in danger right now?
report.callNow: Call the Child Helpline 116 (free) or the police on 999 / 112. You can still send this report too.
report.p1: What happened, and is it still happening?
report.p3: Is the child safe now? Do they need medical help?
report.p4: You do not need to say anyone's name.
report.writeHint: Write in any language you are comfortable with.
report.bothOk: You can record a voice note, write, or do both.
report.replyLanguage: Which language should the police answer you in?
report.replyLanguageHint: Messages from the police will be translated into this language.
report.aiConsent: Use Sunbird AI to understand my report faster
report.aiConsentHint: Your voice note and text are sent securely to Sunbird AI, a Ugandan language-technology service, to turn speech into text, translate it and prepare a summary for the police. A police officer always checks it. If you untick this, an officer will listen to or read your report directly — it may take a little longer.
report.whatNext: A police officer will review your report and answer you within 24 hours in {language}. You will see the answer on your home page.
report.thanksBody: Your report is with the police. Please wait — an officer will get back to you within 24 hours in {language}.
report.answerBy: You will hear from us by {date}
report.waitTitle: Please wait — the police are checking your report
report.waitBody: An officer will answer you in {language} within 24 hours. You do not need to do anything now.
report.needsInfoTitle: The police have a question for you
report.needsInfoBody: Please open your report and answer so the officer can continue.
report.registeredFollow: The police have opened a case. You can now follow every step below.
report.registeredNoFollow: The police have opened a case and are handling it. Thank you for speaking up.
report.notRegisteredTitle: The police have reviewed your report
report.notRegisteredBody: Please read the message from the officer about what to do next.
report.conversationHint: Only you and the officers handling your report can see these messages.
report.privacyBody: For everyone's safety, investigation notes, medical reports and other documents stay with the institutions handling the case. You will see updates, dates you need to attend and messages from your officer.

voice.tapToStop: Tap again when you have finished.
voice.hint: Speak calmly. You can record up to 3 minutes.
voice.micDenied: We could not use the microphone. Please allow microphone access, or write your story instead.
voice.fallback: Your browser cannot record here. You can record with your phone's voice recorder and choose the file.
voice.tooLarge: This recording is too large. Please keep it under 3 minutes.

complaints.title: Reports to verify
complaints.subtitle: Reports from complainants routed to your station. Verify each one before a case is registered.
complaints.sla: Complainants are told they will hear back within 24 hours in their language. Register the case, ask a question or explain the outcome.
complaints.aiSubtitle: Sunbird AI transcription, translation and triage — a draft for you to verify.
complaints.aiRunning: The voice note is being transcribed and translated. This can take a minute or two; refresh shortly.
complaints.aiFailedHint: AI could not process this report ({reason}). Please listen to or read the statement directly.
complaints.noConsent: The complainant chose not to use AI. Please listen to or read the statement directly.
complaints.aiWarning: AI output can be wrong or incomplete. Listen to the voice note or read the statement before deciding. The AI does not decide whether anything is true.
complaints.audioAudited: Every playback is recorded in the audit log.
complaints.conversationHint: Your messages are translated into the complainant's language automatically when possible.
complaints.complainantFollows: The complainant can follow approved updates.
complaints.complainantNotFollowing: The complainant does not have access to the case.
complaints.registerHint: Confirm the details. Registering opens an official case with you as the responsible officer.
complaints.confirmCategory: Pre-filled from AI — confirm or correct.
complaints.concernsHint: Pre-filled with the AI summary; edit to what you verified. Lead institution only.
complaints.allowFollow: Let the complainant follow this case
complaints.allowFollowHint: Only if they are not implicated and it is in the child's best interests. They will see approved updates and dates only.
complaints.followNotPossible: Not available: the complainant reported another family's child.
complaints.messageHint: Write in English; it will be translated into {language} automatically when possible.
complaints.needsInfo: I need more information before deciding
complaints.declineHint: Use when the report cannot be registered (e.g. not a child-protection matter). Tell the complainant kindly where they can get help.

ussdCard.title: No smartphone? Report from any phone
ussdCard.body: Dial the Tuliwamu USSD code to report anonymously. Try how it works with the simulator.

docs.referralSubtitle: Files on this referral are shared only between your institution and {other}.
docs.caseSubtitle: Every document your institution may see for this case. Nobody else on the case can see a document unless it was sent to them.
docs.emptyHint: Upload a file, or wait for the other institution to send one.
docs.chooseFile: Choose a file (PDF, photo or Word)
docs.allowed: PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP or Word (.docx), up to 10 MB. Files are encrypted when stored.
docs.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
docs.title: Title (optional)
docs.forwardable: Allow recipients to forward this document
docs.forwardableHint: For example, police forwarding a medical report to the ODPP. Untick for documents that must stay with the recipient only.
docs.whoSeesReferral: Only your institution and {other} will be able to open this file.
docs.whoSeesCase: Only your institution will be able to open this file until you forward it.
docs.withdrawPrompt: Why are you withdrawing this document? (The file will be deleted; the record stays in the audit log.)
docs.forwardWarning: Only forward what the receiving institution needs for its role. Forwarding is recorded in the audit log.
docs.noTargets: There is no other institution on this case to forward to.
docs.attachReportHint: The file is shared only with {other}. Clinical details stay out of the family portal.
docs.sendWithReferral: Send a document with this referral (optional)
docs.sendWithReferralHint: For example the police case file to the ODPP. Only the receiving institution will be able to open it.
